problem_type: Capability results cross the runtime-to-model boundary as unknown values
symptom: A malformed, oversized, sensitive, or provider-shaped tool result can be rendered as model text without schema, redaction, size, or receipt checks.
direct_cause: runtimePort exposes result as unknown and Pi run.mts calls modelText(decision.result) after capability dispatch.
class_root: There is no unique runtime-to-model typed/safe projection boundary.
affected_population: Every tool result returned by a capability adapter
Canvas, generation, ProductionRun, and artifact outputs
internal_only_reason: The required safe projection is an internal Nomi trust and output contract; current #223 paths are the evidence baseline.
invariants: Every model-visible result is safeParsed against an output schema.
Credentials, private paths, and oversized payloads are redacted or rejected.
A rejected result emits an error code and receiptRef without entering model context.
generality_proof: All capability and MCP adapters return through the runtime port before model context insertion; one projection enforces schema, redaction, size, and provenance for every provider and caller.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: All Host outputs are stored as typed ledger items before projection.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Unknown loop outputs cannot bypass the ledger item boundary.
Ledger replay verifies structured payload persistence.

recurrence.reason: Any new capability, provider, MCP server, or output consumer can return unknown data unless the runtime boundary is closed.
same_class_scan: Searched runtimePort result typing and Pi modelText consumers.
Searched capability outputSchema declarations and MCP projection callers.
Checked canvas and generation result paths as independently shaped outputs.

prevention.invariant: Only safeParse/redact/size-capped/provenance-bearing output may become a model item.
prevention.failure_mode: Schema violation, sensitive path/credential, or size overflow becomes a typed error projection and never raw model text.
prevention.strategy: Replace modelText(unknown) with one safe output projector owned by runtime and require every adapter result to pass it.

legacy_paths.rationale: Typed projection is scoped to the Host ledger in M1; runtime adapter projection remains a later slice.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Schema/redaction ownership is internal; provider SDK versions do not decide the model projection invariant.

migration: Persist full trusted payload and receipt in Host/domain stores; existing renderer projections continue through a bounded safe view. Legacy unknown payloads are not replayed into new model context.
residual_risks: Exact sensitive-field inventory must be finalized with the M4 trust review.
Current checkout does not contain the #223 runtime paths, so this remains a draft until M1/M4 materialize the boundary.
